import json, urllib.parse, urllib.request, time, ssl
selected=json.load(open('afgr_atac_selected_exps.json'))
file_records=[]
ctx=ssl.create_default_context()
for i,e in enumerate(selected):
    acc=e['accession']; sample=e['_igsr_sample']; cell=e['_afgr_cell_name']
    params=[('type','File'),('dataset','/experiments/'+acc+'/'),('output_type','alignments'),('file_format','bam'),('assembly','GRCh38'),('format','json'),('limit','all'),('field','accession'),('field','md5sum'),('field','dataset')]
    url='https://www.encodeproject.org/search/?'+urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    for attempt in range(5):
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30, context=ctx) as r:
                d=json.load(r)
            break
        except Exception as ex:
            print('retry',i,acc,ex, flush=True)
            time.sleep(2)
    else:
        raise RuntimeError('failed '+acc)
    files=d.get('@graph',[])
    if len(files)"'!=1:
        print('"'unexpected file count',acc,len(files),files)
    for f in files:
        f['experiment']=acc
        f['cell_name']=cell
        f['sample']=sample
        file_records.append(f)
    if i%10==0: print('done',i,acc,flush=True)
print('total files',len(file_records))
json.dump(file_records, open('afgr_atac_align_files.json','w'), indent=2)
